scope: Read-only downstream compatibility inventory; no changes to the active CONFIG packet or accepted CODE-PROOF contracts.

findings.fact: Legacy full_commit, code_locator and code-evidence-manifest.v1 require 40-hex commit; production _origin independently enforces exactly 40 hex.
findings.implication: Both Git object formats remain valid in CODE-PROOF, but successor_only handoffs must not be passed to legacy capture even for SHA-1. A separately frozen successor capture/locator contract must bind object_format and full-width commit/tree/blob IDs; no truncation or widening legacy v1.

findings.fact: paper-code-alignment.v1 officiality evidence is pdf_locator only. Existing Markdown source observations carry paper pages and paper/source-version identity, not generic web acquisition provenance.
findings.implication: Relation A may bind existing source-version/Markdown evidence through a compatible successor. B/D web evidence needs a separately specified retained observation and locator; do not invent PDF/page identities for web content.

findings.fact: Legacy canonical_compiler._code consumes one inspected manifest, repo-record.v1 and alignment.v1. Each capability locator must share that manifest source_id; output path is one wiki/code/<repo-slug>.md per repo.
findings.implication: A multi-file relation/collection needs deliberate joins and page identity so distinct path manifests cannot collapse or collide. This is later CODE-CANONICAL work, not proof-kernel acceptance.

findings.fact: R4/R7 intentionally leave source_association_verified=false and retain only the legacy association reference in CODE-PROOF.
findings.implication: The canonical successor must resolve the original association_reference digest and retained receipt/source-ledger/extraction bindings. A valid ce1 reference or Git proof does not supply that authority.

required_later_vectors: SHA-256 capture/locator round trip; reject narrowing into legacy 40-hex input.
Same blob at two logical source paths retains distinct manifest/locator identity.
Multi-file capability evidence resolves each cited source ID/path/commit.
Web A/B/C/D provenance does not counterfeit PDF/Markdown-page captures.
Association from another paper/version and mismatched registration material refuses.
